data.text: OpenAI started rolling out dots to eligible ChatGPT Business Standard members in the US on Nov 19. A dot is an always-on agent that keeps working on a project between chats, so decide what it can do on its own before anyone points one at your files

A tip for your always on agent (grok bot, duet, muse, dots) - always have it set up a routine if you want it to do a repetitive task, otherwise it’ll simply forget as your context piles up

Codebase sweep, email check, whatever it is. Set up a routine or task
